Danna is a Flameshade duergar who can be found in Grymforge during Act One.
“
If you're wantin' the sergeant, she's at the dig. Now scram.
„
— Danna

Involvement

Act One

Danna is loyal to Clan Flameshade. If the party side with  Brithvar, Danna fights with them against  Nere.
